FACT_ID: sec12-R01 | anchor: A158
The posted limit is a ceiling for ideal conditions, not a target, so a slower speed can be legally required when the road, weather or traffic is poor. [A158]
Why it matters: group_hint speed-law; prereq_hint sec12-F20; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec12-F20, sec12-F21.
Source: [A158 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0158]

FACT_ID: sec12-R02 | anchor: A155
A hazard is defined by needing a change in your speed or direction, so a harmless trash can or an upcoming driveway counts just as a running child does. [A155]
Why it matters: group_hint hazards; prereq_hint sec12-F08; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec12-F09.
Source: [A155 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0155]

FACT_ID: sec12-R03 | anchor: A155
Hazard perception is spotting risks before they become problems, while choosing which of several hazards needs the most urgent response is a separate driver duty. [A155]
Why it matters: group_hint hazards; prereq_hint sec12-R02; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec12-F08, sec12-F10.
Source: [A155 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0155]

FACT_ID: sec12-R04 | anchor: A156
Signaling belongs to the communicate step, while rechecking mirrors and looking over your shoulder belong to the check step that follows it. [A156]
Why it matters: group_hint hazard-routine; prereq_hint sec12-F13; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec12-F14, sec12-F15.
Source: [A156 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0156]

FACT_ID: sec12-R05 | anchor: A156
The check step aims for a change that needs at most medium braking, not hard braking, by setting your position and speed first. [A156]
Why it matters: group_hint hazard-routine; prereq_hint sec12-R04; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec12-F15.
Source: [A156 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0156]

FACT_ID: sec12-R06 | anchor: A159
The following gap in this guide is stated as at least two vehicle lengths behind the car ahead, and space may be judged by distance or by time. [A159]
Why it matters: group_hint space; prereq_hint sec12-F23; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec12-F24.
Source: [A159 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0159]

FACT_ID: sec12-R07 | anchor: A160
On an interstate on-ramp the merging driver yields, because traffic already on the interstate holds the right-of-way. [A160]
Why it matters: group_hint merging; prereq_hint sec12-F25; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec12-F26.
Source: [A160 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0160]

FACT_ID: sec12-R08 | anchor: A160
At a slow lane closure the zipper method keeps both lanes in use up to the merge area, rather than everyone moving over early. [A160]
Why it matters: group_hint merging; prereq_hint sec12-R07; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec12-F28, sec12-F27.
Source: [A160 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0160]

FACT_ID: sec12-R09 | anchor: A161
The 15-second marker exercise trains you to estimate distance in seconds, while eye-lead time is the wider habit of scanning far ahead. [A161]
Why it matters: group_hint time; prereq_hint sec12-F30; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec12-F30, sec12-F31.
Source: [A161 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0161]

FACT_ID: sec12-R10 | anchor: A162
Before a left turn across traffic the turning driver yields, and when the gap is uncertain the guide favors waiting for extra time. [A162]
Why it matters: group_hint time; prereq_hint sec12-F33; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec12-F33, sec12-F34.
Source: [A162 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0162]
